responsibility: This header declares the function_base objects for SVE2 and extension-specific SVE intrinsic semantics. It provides extern references in aarch64_sve::functions for the SVE2 operation implementations defined in aarch64-sve-builtins-sve2.cc, allowing the central SVE builtin registration code to attach concrete semantics to the SVE2 intrinsic entries from the definition tables.
same_name_distinction: Within the aarch64-sve-builtins-sve2 trio, this header serves as the declaration layer for extern function_base objects representing SVE2 intrinsic semantics, in contrast to the .cc implementation file and the .def inventory table.
